Laptops graphics Bug Fix RELEASED
notes.content:
Some laptops with NVidia Optimus, AMD Dual Graphics, AMD Hybrid Graphics Technologies Some had problems and graphics bugs: no car bodies, only windows, black cars,damaged textures.
We have fixed this!
Please try out the new update - Version 207 Build 61.

If you have AMD video card and the problems persist, you must disable Dual Graphics in the graphics card settings. It is necessary to use only a discrete video card!

1. Open AMD VISION Engine Control Center (or AMD Catalyst Control Center).
2. Click the Options button and turn on the Advanced View.
3. Tap Games, select AMD Radeon Dual Graphics> Disable AMD Radeon Dual Graphics> Apply.
4. On the desktop, right-click, select "Switchable Graphics Settings" from the drop-down menu.
5. In the "Graphics Settings" section opposite the FURIDASHI.exe application, select the "High Performance"> "Apply" mode.
If FURIDASHI.exe is not listed in the application list, click the Add Application button. This file is located in the directory with the installed Steam games.

If you have the Crimson Edition driver installed:
1. Open the interface settings of the video card Settings Radeon and click the Settings button.
2. Click Advanced Settings.
3. Follow the instructions above.

NEW UPDATE! Version 207 Build 55 | PHYSICS | GAME BALANCE | BUGS FIXED
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29179814/2b09e9334d977157acfaad0f41ac948ec3f80e13.png[/img]
1. PHYSICS
The engine, inertia of the engine and transmission are improved. A radical solution of the problems described by the players. Improved model of tire friction.
The suspension is improved - it works more actively - it's done softer - the rolls are slightly strengthened. Car feels more realistic

2. GAME BALANCE
Redistribution of power of the cars. Now stock cars have become more powerful and are already better prepared for drift

3. BUGS FIXED
Blur the grass - the problem is solved. The error of disabling the interface in the race when the smoke is turned off has been fixed.
In Photo Mode control the camera only from the keyboard. Fixed bug with camera control

HUGE UPDATE! Version 201 Build 35 | VR | PHYSICS | OPTIMIZATION | TANDEM DRIFT | MANUAL SWITCHING | VSYNC | DISCORD
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29179814/577d03bef664f31c89ff1825a41dd64812895264.png[/img]
1. VR (VIRTUAL REALITY)
Full support for all types of VR helmets including Oculus Rift и HTC Vive is implemented. Resetting the VR head position by pressing the F1 key

2. PHYSICS
The power and inertia of the engine was reconfigured. The best acceleration of the car. Drift at a higher speed. Improvement of the friction model of tires. The friction of the tires became denser.

3. OPTIMIZATION
Significant increase in the speed of loading resources, cars and tracks in the game. Shadows are improved. The shimmer of shadows is removed, including the Photo Mode.
Fixed many bugs, optimized, increased stability of the game client

4. TANDEM DRIFT
Tandem drift improved and bugs fixed. When physical collisions is disabled the intersection of car bodies disables the accrual of points for tandem drift.
This will make the drift more beautiful and motivates players to ride online with the included physical collisions. Closer to reality

5. MANUAL SWITCHING
Gearbox was reconfigured. Added the possibility of manual switching for automatic gearbox

6. VERTICAL SYNCHRONIZATION
Added the ability to enable VSYNC in the graphics settings menu

7. DASHBOARD
Added dashboard to car cockpit

8. DISCORD SERVER
FURIDASHI: Drift Cyber Sport Official Discord server started work: http://discord.gg/vDyrJJ4

9. GREEN TREES
Radically solved the problem of "black trees"

HUGE UPDATE! Version 150 Build 85| WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP | TANDEM DRIFT | ORLANDO TRACK | PHYSICS | ULTIMATE 200%
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29179814/772d1c1b8ada13f1a7189dfb13befe71431c8d02.png[/img]
1. WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP.
   Every day a new round of the World Championship is held on a new track. The results of pilots are preserved on the server for World Championship ranking. In the game menu the ratings of the pilots are available based on the results of TODAY'S current ROUND, YESTERDAY'S ROUND and the GLOBAL LEADERBOARD, which is calculated based on the results of the last 10 past rounds of the World Championship.
    In the leaderboard menu you can open the Steam-profile of any of the pilots and add the pilot to friends.
   To participate in the World Championship round you must drive a 5 minute race in any game mode on the track, which has "World Championship Round" red sticker.
   For moving the pilot up in the GLOBAL LEADERBOARD of the World Championship a daily paid 100,000 dollars in-game currency.

2.TANDEM DRIFT.
Added the accrual of PTS and the indicator of tandem drift. In tandem drift players can earn up to 175% PTS compared to a single drift. This is a new way of actively promoting the pilot up in the World Championship.

3. New track ORLANDO is real track for tandem drift known to many.

4. PHYSICS. The front suspension of cars has been reworked. Improved tire's friction. The "CRAB WALK" effect is completely eliminated. Improved steering accuracy.

5. DLC ULTIMATE 200% и FURIDASHI: Drift Cyber Sport - ULTIMATE VERSION with a BIG discount!
This DLC provides 200% of cash payouts in-game currency!

6. The smoke from the tires is completely redesigned. Now the smoke became bulkier.

7. Drift PTS are no longer calculated when the car moves with more than one wheel on the grass.

NEW UPDATE! Version 147 Build 21| GameSTUL.ru | FreeTrack/OpenTrack/TrackIR head tracking!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29179814/0ec3d96a3e4e4151f6f073c26f983925e10dcf11.png[/img]
1. We are glad to inform You about the beginning of cooperation between FURIDASHI: Drift Cyber ​​Sport and GameSTUL.ru - the manufacturer of the best motion simulators!
Implemented support for motion platforms and telemetry transmission using the GameSTUL.ru protocol. This will in the future increase the realism of the sensations of car physics
thanks to "live" testing on motion simulators that transmit tilt and accelerate to the pilot.

2. Added support for head tracking through FreeTrack/OpenTrack/TrackIR.
Our partner FeelCustom creates high quality and accuracy equipment for tracking. Head tracking can provide freedom of vision and a greater immersion in the world
of drifting for players who are not yet ready to use VR because of the high price. FeelCustom equipment prices are much more affordable.

3. Added the ability to automatically rotate the pilot's head for a view from the first person in the direction of steerirng. Two options: Type A - smoother and slower,
  Type B - faster and sharper. You can configure the automatic head rotation in the Settings>Gameplay menu.

P.S. Full VR support comming SOON!

3. The configuration of the game controller is taken out in a separate CONTROLLER OPTIONS menu.

4. The cars capacity was recalculated in accordance with reality.

5. Fixed many bugs, increased stability of the game client.

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29179814/154eed45a6d1e32ad8751411dcd7e3d803edea62.jpg[/img]
1. Improved car physics. The control became more responsive and the cars in drift are more smooth. The transmission and communication of the engine with wheels have been redesigned.
The gearbox settings for all cars in the garage are reset to the new default values

2. 10 Exhaust systems and 3 Turbo kits sounding differently are available for installation on each car.
In combination with 10 engines, which have a unique sound, 300 variants of the car sound are obtained.
You can install the components on the car to your taste

3. Added a new track - HIGASHI JAPAN

4. 5 DLCs with new premium cars are released in full pumping and with unique designs

5. 20 new exclusive designs for Premium cars are added.

6. 11 new music tracks

7. Ability to control the steering wheel of the car with the mouse

8. Added indicator of the steering wheel position. Can be enabled in the SETTINGS>GAMEPLAY menu. It is displayed only when the steer is assigned to an analog controller (steering wheel, stick, mouse)

9. Car horn signal has been added. Additional convenient means of communication of players online

10. Function of Recovery the car on the track. Assign a button in the SETTINGS>CONTROLS menu.

11. Description of technical settings in TUNING menu

12. Fixed many bugs, increased stability of the game client.

UPDATE RELEASED! Version 107 Build 15
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29179814/8d13f77f0e316b9964abc8c39c1b66ba5c6adc63.png[/img]

1. Added network anti-aliasing, prediction and anti-lag technology.
Movement of cars of competitors became as smooth as possible. Network latency is minimized. Tandem drift is available as never before in any drift simulator.

2. Added a new track - AIRCRAFT CARRIER. PACIFIC OCEAN. This track is perfect for tandem drifting.

3. The physical models of all the tracks in the game are revised and detailed. Holes are closed, the "magic" pylons are fixed. Physical geometry has become more accurate.

4. 3 DLCs with new premium cars are released in full pumping and with unique designs.

5. Adjust visual quality of the cars of competitors in the menu Options>Graphics.

6. Detailed and improved visualization of asphalt in the game.

7. Global chat in the game with the ability to view Steam players profiles and adding to friends.

8. Display the Global chat in Free Practice mode and Races With Ghosts of other players.  Allows you to communicate and monitor the creation of Online Competition.

9. It is possible to write long messages in the Lobby Chat and Global Chat.

10. In the Online Competitions menu and the Lobby menu shows the time remaining until the end of the current session. This lets you know how long to wait for a new session to begin.

11. Save the game after each session to avoid losing progress and achievements.

12. Fixed many bugs, increased stability of the game client.

notes.title: Game is released!
notes.content:
Dear drift fans!

We are glad to inform you that the release of the project FURIDASHI: Drift Cyber Sport took place!
Now you can join the world of cyber drift. Take part in online competitions with real gamers from around the world.
Or arrange a meeting with your Steam friends on the sports track.

Join our project - we will try to make it interesting!
Work on the game continues - will be added new game modes, new cars, new tracks, car physics will continue the detailing.

We ask you to express your ideas and suggestions on the further development of the project.
You can create a topic with a suggestion in the Steam community hub or describe your suggestions in the reviews about the game.

Enjoy Your Drift!
